study type: Observational cohort study (secondary analysis of a multicenter randomized controlled trial)
exposure: Induction of labor (IOL) at early term (37(+0)-38(+6) weeks)
outcome: Neonatal intensive care unit (NICU) admission for >4 hours
Need for a second induction method
Time from start of IOL to birth
cohort: 1087 New Zealand women with a planned IOL ≥37(+0) weeks gestation
finding: IOL for a non-urgent indication at early term was associated with increased odds of NICU admission for >4 hours and longer time from IOL to birth compared to IOL at full term.
birth_weight: Adjusted for in neonatal outcome analysis
